name: Chioma
bio: Golden hour on a Lagos rooftop, Chapman in hand, laughing at your bad jokes on purpose. Buy the second round and I'll teach you to dance properly.

prompts.answer: Rooftop sunset, suya at midnight, and someone walking me home slower than necessary.
Tell me my laugh is contagious. It is, and I'll prove it.

name: Pranav
bio: Third-wave coffee snob from Indiranagar with a window seat reserved for whoever can out-argue me about filter kaapi. I'll split the croissant. Maybe.

prompts.answer: Steal my window seat, then ask what I'm reading. Bold and literate is my whole type.
Slow pour-over, a long ride to Nandi Hills, lazy kisses between podcast episodes.

name: Hana
bio: Leather jacket, neon streets, zero plans before midnight. Find me between a pojangmacha and a noraebang, stealing your fries and your attention.

prompts.answer: A karaoke diva with suspiciously good range. Duet with me if you can keep up.
Eye contact across the street, then pretending I wasn't looking. Classic.

name: Callum
bio: Weekdays in Toronto, weekends somewhere with no signal and a better view. I pack extra snacks and an extra hoodie, in case you get cold. You will.

prompts.answer: A cabin in Algonquin, a lake at sunrise, and nowhere to be until Monday.
Offering my jacket before you ask. Getting it back is optional.

name: Robin
bio: Gallery openings in Mitte, then wherever the night takes us. Sharp blazer, soft heart, terrible at small talk, very good at the long kind.

prompts.answer: We stand in front of the same painting for twenty minutes and neither of us mentions it.
Curious, unbothered, dangerous.

name: Gianna
bio: Nonna's sugo recipe, Little Italy apartment, way too much basil on the windowsill. Come for dinner, stay for dessert, wash a dish or two to earn seconds.

prompts.answer: Feeding you until you beg me to stop, then feeding you tiramisu.
Bring wine. Stir the sauce when I tell you. Taste it off my spoon.

name: Malcolm
bio: Pickup games in Harlem, dollar slices after. I talk a little trash on the court and a lot less once you're sitting next to me.

prompts.answer: Your jump shot. And your face when I let you win the first game.
Asked for her number mid-game. Missed the shot, got the number.

name: Zoya
bio: Lost in the shelves at Khan Market with an Urdu poetry collection and a chai going cold. Read me a line you love and I'll pretend I'm not swooning.

prompts.answer: A Faiz couplet, slowly. Mispronounce one word and I'll correct you with a kiss.
Books stacked as furniture, fairy lights, and one very judgmental cat.

name: Adrian
bio: Natural wine bars in Tiong Bahru are my natural habitat. I'll pick the bottle, you pick the topic, and we'll both pretend we're only staying for one glass.

prompts.answer: Second dates should be dinner I cook. First dates should end before we want them to.
I can identify a Burgundy blindfolded. Want to test me?

name: Fiona
bio: Saturday markets in Bondi, tote bag full of things I swore I wouldn't buy. Cook with me and I'll let you taste everything first.

prompts.answer: Ripe mangoes, salty hair, and a long lunch that turns into dinner.
Like a market haul: colourful, a bit messy, and better than you planned.

name: Rui
bio: Linen shirt, salty hair, Cascais boardwalk at noon. I'll teach you to surf if you promise to laugh when I fall off too.

prompts.answer: Ditch the dinner reservation and catch the sunset at the beach with me instead.
Sun-kissed shoulders and someone who flirts in two languages.

name: Pooja
bio: Festival-season regular who lives for the drop. Find me front row in Vagator with glitter on my cheeks and room in my plans for one more.

prompts.answer: Unstoppable until sunrise. Hydrate, keep up, steal a kiss at the drop.
Probably on a scooter, hair everywhere, looking for the next beach party.

name: Sky
bio: Digging through vinyl in Silver Lake every Sunday. Lavender hair, softer heart. Make me a playlist and I'll know exactly what you mean.

prompts.answer: Mixtapes. Notes in margins. Sharing headphones on the bus.
I judge people by their first record and I'm always secretly charmed.

name: Ethan
bio: Me and Biscuit, Prospect Park, every morning. He's the real catch; I'm the guy who makes brunch afterwards. Package deal.

prompts.answer: You'll throw the ball for my dog and let me buy the coffee.
My dog has more followers than me. I've never lost at Catan. I'm a morning person.

name: Mariana
bio: Plant mum in Coyoacán with a greenhouse habit. I'll name a fern after you if the first date goes well. Very high honour.

prompts.answer: Forty-two plants, a hammock, and lighting that's terrible for anything but kissing.
New leaves unfurling, café de olla, rain on a tin roof.

name: Yousef
bio: I roast coffee in Al Quoz and take it way too seriously. Let me make you a pour-over and watch your face when you realise it tastes like blueberries.

prompts.answer: Latte art. I can do a heart, a swan, and something that looks like your name.
Ask me a question and actually listen to the answer.

name: Claire
bio: Winter in New York is my whole personality: the rink in Bryant Park, hot cocoa, holding hands for 'balance.' Catch me if I wobble.

prompts.answer: Zero to ten? Under the rink lights, easily an eleven.
Skating, a cheesy movie, and someone who keeps my hands warm.

name: Kwame
bio: Soho jazz bars, a neat whisky and a conversation that runs past last orders. I'm smooth, but I'll still get nervous when you smile at me.

prompts.answer: 'One more song.' Works every time.
A woman who knows exactly what she's ordering.

name: Akinyi
bio: Painter in Kilimani, paint on my overalls and my cheek. Sit still and let me sketch you. Fair warning: my muse always ends up staying for dinner.

prompts.answer: Paint a lover's portrait from memory after one unforgettable night.
You stop talking mid-sentence because you caught me staring.

name: Jack
bio: Skatepark at sunset, servo pies after. Grazed knees, good intentions. Let's go somewhere spontaneous and tell everyone it was your idea.

prompts.answer: No skating after dark. The lights are better then.
Talks me into one more session, then one more drink.

name: Remi
bio: Brick Lane thrift queen with an eye for a bold print and a bolder flirt. I'll style you for a night out, then steal your jacket by the end of it.

prompts.answer: Pulling a vintage jacket off the rack that fits you perfectly. Nobody can resist.
Your shoes. Lovingly. Constantly.

name: Margaux
bio: Picnics by the Canal Saint-Martin with too many strawberries and a very good rosé. Bring a baguette and your best story, mon chéri.

prompts.answer: Gingham blanket, sun on my shoulders, feeding you strawberries between pages.
Packing your favourite snacks without being asked.

name: Rajiv
bio: Weekend sailor off the Gateway, weekday founder. Silver in the beard, mischief in the eyes. Let's sail to Alibaug and miss the last ferry back.

prompts.answer: A slow sail down the Konkan coast, stopping wherever the sunset is best.
Tell me I'm a good listener. Then let me prove it.

name: Fah
bio: Night markets are my love language. I'll feed you the spiciest skewer in Ratchada and wink when your eyes start watering. Cute.

prompts.answer: Thai spicy, in food and in flirting. Keep milk nearby.
I've eaten a scorpion. I can't whistle. I've never winked at a stranger.

name: Tane
bio: Island boy living by the beach in Maroubra. Early surf, slow mornings, ukulele by the fire. I'll cook, you pick the sunset spot.

prompts.answer: Salt water, a hot pie after the surf, and someone singing badly with me.
Like island time: unhurried, warm, and you'll forget your phone exists.

name: Nina
bio: City job, mountain heart. I escape Toronto every long weekend for a lake I can jump into. Keep up on the trail and I'll share my thermos.

prompts.answer: Jumped into a glacier lake on a dare. Then made him warm me up.
Banff in October, no phones, one sleeping bag, two very cold people.

name: Javier
bio: Taco crawler, moustache enthusiast, salsa macha evangelist. I know every taquería in Roma Norte and I'll share my last al pastor with you. Romance.

prompts.answer: Three tacos at 2 a.m. after promising myself just one.
Are you salsa verde? Because I want you on everything.

name: Mariam
bio: Jumeirah café regular, croissant critic, hopeless romantic in a pastel hijab. Impress me with your conversation, not your car.

prompts.answer: Remember my coffee order on the second date. That's the whole test.
Coffee dates beat dinner. Less pressure, more eye contact.

name: Jihoon
bio: Bouldering in Seongsu after work, chalk on everything. I'll spot you on the wall and buy the tteokbokki after. Strong grip, gentle hands.

prompts.answer: A V6 problem I've been projecting for months. Come watch me finally send it.
Cheer for me on the wall even when I fall off.

name: Jasmine
bio: Bushwick murals, crop tops and confidence. If you can keep up with my walk, you can keep up with my mouth. Bring the energy.

prompts.answer: Tell me the outfit's working. I already know, I just like hearing it.
The reason the DJ plays one more song.

name: Sacha
bio: Le Marais bartender after hours, silver hair and a slow smile. I'll make you something off-menu and watch you decide whether to trust me.

prompts.answer: My signature cocktail has a secret ingredient. I only tell people I've kissed.
A very good listener with very bad intentions.

name: Julien
bio: Baker in the 11th with flour on my sleeves and butter on my mind. Date me and you'll never buy a croissant again. Waking up early is the catch.

prompts.answer: Warm bread at dawn, delivered to your door with a terrible pun.
Kneading dough with my sleeves rolled up. I know what I'm doing.

name: Kavita
bio: Saree on, city lights below, a Worli rooftop and a playlist of old Rafi songs. I'm a grown woman who knows what she wants. Let's find out if it's you.

prompts.answer: A man who can dance to retro Bollywood without irony.
Rooftop dinner, a slow dance in the lift, a long drive over the sea link.

name: Femi
bio: Afro-soul songwriter in Yaba. I write love songs for a living, so be careful: you might end up in a chorus. Come by the studio, I'll play you the new one.

prompts.answer: Writing a hook I'll swear isn't about you.
I tuned my guitar to your laugh. It's in the key of trouble.

name: Camila
bio: Forró teacher in Pinheiros. Can't dance? Perfect: I'll teach you, very close, very slowly. Leading is optional, chemistry is not.

prompts.answer: Leading, then letting you think you're leading.
Pulls me onto the floor before I finish my caipirinha.

name: Miguel
bio: Architect cycling the hills of Lisbon so you don't have to. Let me show you the hidden miradouros, the best pastéis and my questionable poetry.

prompts.answer: Ride on the back of my bike down to the river at sunset.
Laugh at my tour-guide voice. I'm sensitive about it.

name: Haruka
bio: Weekdays in Tokyo, weekends in Niseko powder. Best part of skiing? The fireplace after. Save me a spot and a blanket.

prompts.answer: Onsen, hot cocoa, fire crackling, and absolutely nowhere to be.
Fresh snow, wool socks, someone warm to lean on.

name: Theo
bio: Bookseller in Notting Hill, shy until I'm not. I'll recommend you a novel and secretly hope you text me about chapter three.

prompts.answer: I hide notes in the books I recommend. Check page 42.
Clever, kind, slightly chaotic.

name: Lily
bio: Desert festivals, golden hour fields, sun hat permanently on. Let's lose our friends in the crowd on purpose and find each other at the ferris wheel.

prompts.answer: Sunset set, glitter everywhere, a shared blanket under the stars.
Never have I ever left a festival with the same plans I arrived with.

name: Kamau
bio: Chef in Westlands who still shops the market by hand. I'll pick the ripest fruit for you and grill nyama choma that will ruin other dates for you.

prompts.answer: A perfectly ripe peach. Or you, apparently.
A Sunday feast for twelve, made for just the two of us.

name: Ale
bio: Tattoo artist in Roma with an iced coffee permanently in hand. Ask about my ink and I'll tell you a story for every line. Some are even true.

prompts.answer: You ask where my tattoos end. I smile and say 'second date.'
I've drawn flash inspired by people I've had crushes on.

name: Nicole
bio: Weekend escapes from LA to wine country, a glass in hand and no rush to get back. Pour me something good and tell me what you really want.

prompts.answer: A Sonoma pinot and a man with a plan.
Vineyard sunset, a long dinner, a longer drive home with the windows down.

name: Lucas
bio: Paulista nights, rooftop views, a confident smirk I'm told is a problem. Let's find the party nobody posted about.

prompts.answer: Your favourite bad idea.
Booked us a rooftop table before I even had your number. It worked.

name: Mio
bio: Hanami season is my favourite excuse to wander Meguro with a camera. Walk with me under the blossoms and I'll take your best photo ever.

prompts.answer: Petals in my hair, warm canned coffee, and a quiet hand to hold.
Taking photos of you when you're not looking. You'll like them, promise.

name: Graham
bio: Toronto carpenter with a cabin in Muskoka and a coffee on every porch step. I build things that last. Including, apparently, a very long first conversation.

prompts.answer: Fire in the stove, coffee on the porch, your cold feet on my lap.
Built her a bookshelf after the third date. Bit much. Worked anyway.

name: Leonor
bio: Ocean breeze on the Cascais line, sunglasses on my head, plans optional. Catch me before the sun goes down; after that I'm harder to find.

prompts.answer: Piri-piri on everything. Life too.
Jump off the jetty with me. Clothes on, obviously.

name: Aniket
bio: Ultimate frisbee Sundays in Pune, misal pav after. I throw a mean forehand and a meaner pun. Catch both and you've earned a date.

prompts.answer: How you'll definitely drop the first throw. Then I'll teach you properly.
I've run a marathon. I've eaten five vada pav in one sitting. I'm not competitive.

name: Hattie
bio: Hackney bowling league captain with a competitive streak and a soft spot for losers. Lose to me gracefully and I'll buy the next round.

prompts.answer: Bowling shoes are sexy. Fight me.
Bet a kiss on a strike. Bowled a strike.

name: Kenji
bio: I've ranked every ramen counter in Shinjuku. Slurping loudly is respect here, so come hungry and don't be shy. The best bowls are after midnight.

prompts.answer: A second bowl. Extra chashu. No regrets.
Know your broth: tonkotsu, shoyu or miso? Choose wisely.

name: Rosa
bio: My garden in Coyoacán is my therapy and my love letter. I'll cut you sunflowers, cook you mole and teach you a bolero if you're patient.

prompts.answer: Like my garden: generous, a little wild, always in bloom.
Fresh flowers on your doorstep and a pot of something on the stove.

name: Wen
bio: Monsoon walks under a clear umbrella, kopi in the other hand. Quiet until I trust you, then I won't stop sending you film recommendations.

prompts.answer: Rain on the umbrella, wet pavement shining, a cinema seat in the back row.
We share an umbrella and both pretend it's not on purpose.

name: Jonas
bio: Front row at every gig in Kreuzberg, voice gone by the encore. Shout your favourite song in my ear and I'll take that as a love confession.

prompts.answer: All jumping, no rhythm, maximum joy.
Crowd-surfed at a festival and landed next to my now-ex. Long story, buy me a beer.

name: Nok
bio: Mint-green scooter, Ari café-hopping, helmet hair I've made peace with. Hop on the back and I'll take you to the best khao man gai in Bangkok.

prompts.answer: Ride pillion through Bangkok traffic. Hold on tight. Tighter.
Chiang Mai by scooter, three days, zero plans.

name: Malik
bio: Trinity Bellwoods chess hustler, cardigan enthusiast, cheater at nothing except flirting. Beat me and I'll take you to dinner. Lose and I still will.

prompts.answer: Your opening move. I've already planned five moves ahead.
A queen's gambit. On the board and off it.

name: Greta
bio: Marine biologist who will absolutely tell you jellyfish facts on a date. They have no brain and still glow. I relate. Be my plus-one at the aquarium.

prompts.answer: I've named every jellyfish at the aquarium. Ask me about Kevin.
A fact I don't know. It's harder than you'd think.

name: Mateo
bio: Desert soul in an LA zip code. I'll drive us out to Joshua Tree for the kind of stars you can't see from the city. Bring a jacket, I'll bring the stories.

prompts.answer: A canyon at sunrise, a thermos of coffee, and no signal for miles.
Quiet confidence. Comfortable silence. Good boots.

name: Ife
bio: Arcade bar regular in Lekki with a high score to protect. Challenge me to a fighting game: winner picks the next date, loser buys the drinks.

prompts.answer: A twenty-hit combo. Don't blink.
Saved my number in his phone as 'Player 2'.

name: Bruno
bio: I own a little padaria in Vila Madalena and I'm up at 4 a.m. baking pão de queijo. Date me and breakfast is handled for life.

prompts.answer: Warm bread in bed. Crumbs are a small price to pay.
Cafezinho, the smell of the oven, Sunday football with you beside me.

name: Antoine
bio: Literature professor who spends too long in old Paris libraries. I'll whisper Baudelaire to you in a dim wine bar and pretend I'm not showing off.

prompts.answer: Your favourite line from a book you've never told anyone about.
Witty, well-read, a little wicked.

name: Emma
bio: Snow days in Prenzlauer Berg, scarf up to my nose, Glühwein in hand. Looking for someone to keep my hands warm until spring.

prompts.answer: Snowfall, a fireplace, board games and very competitive cuddling.
Tell me I've got a great laugh. I'll do it again, just for you.

name: Ananya
bio: Marine Drive at dusk, sea breeze, little black dress doing exactly what it was designed to do. Walk the Queen's Necklace with me and see where the night ends up.

prompts.answer: Cutting chai on Marine Drive at 1 a.m., your jacket on my shoulders.
A man who opens with a compliment that isn't about my looks. Then one that is.

name: Kabir
bio: Lower Parel rooftops, linen shirts and a gin I'll insist you try. I'm the guy who knows the bartender, the DJ and the shortcut home. Shall we?

prompts.answer: Ordering for you, getting it exactly right, acting like it was luck.
Still on the rooftop convincing you the night is young. It is.

name: Zara
bio: Bandra girl, red dress, a laugh you can hear from Carter Road. I'll steal your fries, quote your texts back at you and make you blush at least twice.

prompts.answer: Your Bandra parking skills. Or lack thereof.
Rate it yourself after the second date. I'm confident.

name: Arjun
bio: Banker by day, old-fashioned connoisseur by night. Velvet booths, good whisky, better conversation. I'll book the table; you bring the trouble.

prompts.answer: First dates deserve a proper bar, a proper outfit and a proper goodbye kiss.
Orders a second round and dares me to cancel my morning meeting.

name: Meera
bio: Diyas lit, jasmine in my hair, emerald silk and a soft spot for fireworks. Light a sparkler with me this Diwali and I'll save you the last kaju katli.

prompts.answer: Feeding you sweets with my own hands. Very traditional. Very effective.
'You look stunning in that saree.' Then say it again in Marathi.

name: Kiran
bio: Buzz cut, oversized blazer, Bandra after dark. I'm the one at the bar who looks unbothered and is very much bothered by you. Come say hi.

prompts.answer: Your favourite person on the dance floor and the last to leave it.
Bold, kind, a little dangerous.

name: Vihaan
bio: Bandstand at golden hour, sea link behind me, workout done, ego intact. I'll race you down the promenade and buy the bhutta if I lose. I won't lose.

prompts.answer: How long you take to get ready. Worth the wait though.
Doing every hook step from every Bollywood song since 2010.

name: Nandini
bio: Colaba wine bars, candlelight and a red I'll let you pick. Divorced, delighted and done with boring. Impress me with a story I haven't heard.

prompts.answer: A good Nebbiolo and someone who listens with their whole face.
'No dessert after ten.' Life is short. Order two spoons.

name: Rohan
bio: Juhu sunset walks, salt-and-pepper beard, linen I'll never iron. Architect, single dad, excellent cook. Looking for someone who laughs easily and stays for dinner.

prompts.answer: A long beach walk, pav bhaji at the stalls, then a nap I won't apologise for.
Tell me the grey suits me. I'll pretend I didn't hear and blush anyway.

name: Ishita
bio: Every Delhi wedding season, I'm the one choreographing the sangeet. Blush lehenga, mehendi still fresh. Can you dance? Asking for my heart.

prompts.answer: Leading the whole baraat. Join me or get out of the way.
Crash a wedding with me. Dress code: dazzling.

name: Aditya
bio: Hauz Khas rooftop, leather jacket, lake lights behind me. I know which bar has the best DJ tonight and which has the quietest corner. Pick one.

prompts.answer: Driving you across town for a kebab you'll thank me for.
Is your name Hauz Khas? Because I keep finding my way back to you.

name: Saanvi
bio: HKV café hopper, Sarojini thrift queen, Scorpio with a cocktail. I'll read your chart and decide if you're trouble. Spoiler: I like trouble.

prompts.answer: Someone who texts 'wyd' at midnight. I'll answer.
Never have I ever said no to one last drink in Hauz Khas.

name: Siddharth
bio: Diwali host, card-party champion, my mum's favourite son. Kurta pressed, diyas lit, teen patti chips counted. Come for the party, stay for the conversation after.

prompts.answer: Teen patti. I'll let you win the first hand.
Saving you the best mithai before the aunties get to it.

name: Tara
bio: Aerocity lounges, little black dress, red wine and very little patience for small talk. Consultant who travels too much. Make me want to cancel a flight.

prompts.answer: Gave a stranger my lounge guest pass. We're still in touch.
A well-cut suit and someone who isn't intimidated by me.

name: Karan
bio: 6 a.m. runs through Lodhi Garden, tombs at golden hour, cold coffee after. I'll pace you, stretch with you and absolutely flirt between sets.

prompts.answer: Morning light on the Lodhi tombs, a runner's high, chai with you after.
Show up for the run even if you hate running. Bonus if you complain cutely.

name: Noor
bio: Mehrauli rooftops, Sufi poetry, silver on every finger. I write ghazals I'm too shy to share. Sit with me at sunset and I might read you one.

prompts.answer: A line of Rumi, slowly, like you mean it.
I've written poems about strangers on the metro. All very flattering.

name: Priya
bio: Lawyer, closer, Connaught Place regular. A red blazer means I mean business; red lipstick means I'm off duty. Let's argue over dinner and both win.

prompts.answer: If we're still debating at dessert, the date's a success.
A rebuttal I can't immediately counter. Then a kiss.

name: Nikhil
bio: Microbrewery tasting flight, denim shirt, stand-up open mic after. Bengaluru techie with weekend plans to Coorg. Split a pitcher with me?

prompts.answer: The IPA is overrated. The wheat beer is underrated. So am I.
Brewery, comedy gig, dosa at 1 a.m., a long walk home.

name: Divya
bio: Indiranagar café patios, curls refusing to behave, cold brew in hand. Product designer who notices everything, including you checking me out. Hi.

prompts.answer: Plants, prints, a reading nook and a very cosy blanket.
Long voice notes and surprise filter coffee.

name: Rahul
bio: Bassist in a Bengaluru indie band, which means I'm either on stage or at the bar after. Request a song and I'll dedicate it to you, loudly.

prompts.answer: Your favourite song. I'll learn it by Friday.
The guy convincing the band to play one more encore.

name: Sneha
bio: Cubbon Park runs at sunrise, smoothie at seven, desk at nine. Keep up on the trail and I'll let you buy me dosa after.

prompts.answer: Medium in food, extra hot in competitive sports.
Signed up for a half marathon to impress a guy. Beat him.

name: Ari
bio: Illustrator on a Koramangala rooftop, vintage shirt, chin-in-hand flirt. I'll sketch you on a napkin and you can keep it if you text first.

prompts.answer: A napkin portrait that's slightly too flattering. You're welcome.
The conversation is so good the waiter stops asking if we need anything.

name: Vikram
bio: Founder, runner, terrible at switching off, great at rooftops on MG Road. Looking for someone who makes me forget to check my phone. High bar, sure.

prompts.answer: A good old fashioned and a woman with a plan.
Like a startup: ambitious, occasionally chaotic, always worth it.

name: Kavya
bio: Brewery terrace, string lights, one-shoulder top and a glass of red. Copywriter with a wicked tongue. If you can keep up with my banter, you can keep up with me.

prompts.answer: Mild roasting, followed by a compliment so good you forget the roast.
Can make me laugh with my mouth full. Respectfully.

name: Aarav
bio: Church Street at night, curls doing their own thing, backpack full of snacks. I'll take you to the comic shop, then the bar, then the 2 a.m. biryani spot.

prompts.answer: Ranked matches and texting you between rounds.
Funny, nerdy, unafraid.

name: Aditi
bio: Koregaon Park garden cafés, mustard dress, Marathi poetry on my phone. I'm sweet until you challenge me at Scrabble. Then I'm ruthless.

prompts.answer: I've read every Pu La Deshpande book. I can't cook. I've never lost at Scrabble.
A monsoon drive to the ghats with cutting chai on the way.

name: Sahil
bio: Pune rooftop at blue hour, olive shirt, whisky sour. Engineer who drives too fast on the expressway and slows down for good company.

prompts.answer: 'Just one drink.' It has never once been one drink.
Rooftop drinks, a drive to Sinhagad for midnight bhajis, sunrise views.

name: Gauri
bio: Ganpati festival nights, paithani silk, nath glinting in the lantern light. I play the dhol louder than the boys. Come dance with our pathak.

prompts.answer: Dhol-tasha. Stand close, you'll feel it in your chest.
Like a festival: loud, colourful and full of sweets.

name: Omkar
bio: Leather jacket, old motorcycle, Pune lights spread out below the ghats. I know a dozen sunset points and two very good dhabas. Spare helmet included.

prompts.answer: Ride to Tamhini Ghat at dawn and hold on like you mean it.
Someone who isn't scared of a little rain on a ride.

name: Imran
bio: Old City nights, Irani chai by the Charminar, biryani debates I always win. I'll show you Hyderabad the way my grandfather showed me. Bring an appetite.

prompts.answer: Hyderabadi. Do not underestimate the mirchi ka salan.
An Urdu sher. I'll answer with one of my own.

name: Ayesha
bio: Laad Bazaar is my happy place: glass bangles, lantern light and haleem in Ramzan. Teal anarkali, kohl-lined eyes, very high standards for biryani.

prompts.answer: The clink of new bangles, Osmania biscuits dunked in chai, someone who remembers my order.
Double ka meetha. And a man who brings me a second portion.

name: Varun
bio: Gym at six, code at ten, Jubilee Hills rooftop by nine p.m. I lift heavy and text light. Come find out which one I'm better at.

prompts.answer: Asked the DJ to play our song before we had one.
How you'll definitely skip leg day with me.

name: Sana
bio: Hitech City by day, satin and denim by night. UX designer, Gemini, romcom apologist. Let's skip the small talk and go straight to the slightly-too-honest talk.

prompts.answer: Romcoms are documentaries. Prove me wrong.
On a scale of one to 'missed my last metro'? Solid ten.

name: Nila
bio: Bharatanatyam dancer from Mylapore, jasmine in my braid, kanjeevaram for every occasion. December music season is my love language. Take me to a kutcheri?

prompts.answer: A full varnam. Watch my eyes, that's where the flirting is.
Filter coffee in bed and Ilaiyaraaja on the speaker.

name: Karthik
bio: Besant Nagar beach walks, sundal from the cart, sunsets I narrate like a Mani Ratnam film. Barefoot by choice. Will absolutely sing you a Rahman song.

prompts.answer: Are you a Rahman song? Because you've been stuck in my head on repeat.
Elliot's Beach at dawn, idli and filter coffee, a long nap, a longer phone call.

name: Janani
bio: Red satin on a city rooftop, curls on full volume. Ad-film producer with a very loud laugh. If you can make me snort-laugh, you've already won.

prompts.answer: Kuthu-ready at all times. Keep up or get out of the circle.
The girl who wants to drive to the beach and watch the waves.

name: Arvind
bio: ECR beach café regular, beige blazer, too many filter-coffee opinions. Doctor who finally learned to take weekends off. Let's spend one together.

prompts.answer: A first date at sunset by the sea is cheating. I'll cheat.
Cooking you a Chettinad meal so good you text your friends about it.

name: Ritika
bio: Pujo is my whole year: lal-paar saree, pandal-hopping till sunrise, phuchka on every corner. Find me at Ashtami and steal me away for the dhunuchi dance.

prompts.answer: Dhunuchi naach with incense smoke and zero fear.
Rabindrasangeet, off-key but heartfelt.

name: Anirban
bio: Park Street jazz, Satyajit Ray marathons, adda that runs past midnight. I'm the bespectacled one who'll quote Feluda and pay for the kathi roll.

prompts.answer: Our adda outlasts two rounds of chai and the waiter's patience.
Kolkata biryani with the potato is the superior biryani. Debate me over one.

name: Srijita
bio: Jazz nights on Park Street, black satin, a blazer I'll lend you if you're cold. Grad student by day, regular at the bar where the saxophone sounds sad.

prompts.answer: A saxophone solo and a stranger who knows when to stop talking.
Long eye contact over the rim of my wine glass.

name: Rumi
bio: Prinsep Ghat at dusk, Howrah Bridge lighting up behind me, a notebook of half-finished poems. Filmmaker, soft-spoken, very good at long silences.

prompts.answer: Boat rides on the Hooghly, rain on old buildings, someone humming next to me.
I've never finished a poem I liked. Maybe you'll be the ending.

name: Tanya
bio: Left my Mumbai job for beach-shack life in Goa. White dress, sandy feet, a sunset feni cocktail. Stay for one sunset. Most people stay for the season.

prompts.answer: Gokarna by scooter, one backpack, no return date.
Dancing barefoot at a beach party you didn't know existed.

name: Dev
bio: Runs a beach bar in Anjuna, wears loud shirts by contractual obligation. I make the best kokum mojito on the coast. First one's free, the second costs a dance.

prompts.answer: Remembering your drink, your song and how you take your sunsets.
Starts with a full-moon party, a lost scooter key and a very kind fisherman.

name: Natasha
bio: Fontainhas girl, colourful houses, red lips and a family bebinca recipe I'll guard with my life. Take me to a village feast and dance the mando with me.

prompts.answer: Bebinca and a bottle of port wine on a balcony.
One to ten? Let's say I give out a lot of elevens.

name: Ryan
bio: Born in Candolim, raised on fish curry and football. Linen shirt, beach club, no curfew. I'll teach you to surf at Morjim if you teach me to slow dance.

prompts.answer: Shoes off, sand everywhere, dancing like my grandmother is watching. She'd approve.
Wants to watch the sunrise after the club closes.

name: Mehak
bio: Jaipur born, palace courtyards at dusk, a red lehenga I definitely don't save for weddings. Bridal-wear designer who believes in big romance and bigger earrings.

prompts.answer: Lantern-lit dinner at a haveli, ghoomar under the stars, kulfi on the way home.
Tell me you love the details. I put a lot of thought into them.

name: Raghav
bio: Heritage hotelier, bandhgala enthusiast, rooftop sunsets over the Pink City with Nahargarh glowing behind. Let me take you on a royal tour, minus the elephants.

prompts.answer: A desert camp in Jaisalmer, a sky full of stars and folk music by the fire.
Knowing which rooftop has the best view, and the best laal maas.

name: Neel
bio: Block printer from Sanganer, ink under my nails, chai on a rooftop with the old city glowing. I'll print you a scarf if you stay for one more cup.

prompts.answer: Indigo stains, wooden blocks, plants and a stack of handwritten letters.
Asking about my work and actually wanting the long answer.

name: Harman
bio: Sector 17 nights, sharp blazer, turban matched to my mood. Bhangra-certified, mum's-parathas-approved. Looking for my partner in crime and in bhangra.

prompts.answer: Bhangra so good the aunties start cheering.
Lassi in a steel glass, a long drive to the hills, a laugh that won't stop.

name: Simran
bio: Sukhna Lake sunsets, black jumpsuit, Punjabi playlist on blast. I'm loud, I'm loyal and I'll out-dance you at any party. Kasauli road trip this weekend?

prompts.answer: Your car playlist. Hand me the aux.
Punjabi tadka in food, Punjabi energy in life. Full volume.

name: Manveer
bio: Personal trainer by Sukhna Lake, sunrise runs, makkhan on the parathas anyway. I'll carry your bags, your groceries and you, if you get tired on a hike.

prompts.answer: A sunrise run that ends with a breakfast I cooked.
Acts of service. And protein-packed breakfasts.

name: Krisha
bio: Nine nights of Navratri, nine different chaniya cholis, zero tired feet. If you can keep up through the garba, you can keep up with me. Manek Chowk after?

prompts.answer: Twirling until the dhol stops. It never does.
Late-night dabeli at Manek Chowk.

name: Parth
bio: Dandiya champion of Satellite, kediyu pressed, sticks ready. Textile engineer with a sweet tooth and an embarrassing collection of garba playlists.

prompts.answer: Dandiya partner for tonight? I promise not to hit your fingers.
Fafda, jalebi and laughing at my dad jokes before I'm a dad.

name: Diya
bio: Fort Kochi sunsets by the Chinese fishing nets, kasavu cotton, salt in my hair. Marine biologist turned café owner. Let me show you my favourite backwater.

prompts.answer: A houseboat in Alleppey, monsoon rain, karimeen on the deck.
Banana chips, rain on the backwaters, a good book on a swing.

name: Joel
bio: Heritage café in Fort Kochi, linen shirt, appam and stew on my mind. Guitarist in the Sunday choir and the Saturday pub-quiz team. Equal devotion.

prompts.answer: I've played at the Biennale. I can't swim. I make the best beef fry in Kochi.
Morning mass, a long lunch, an evening walk along the harbour.

name: Riya
bio: Soho cocktail bars, emerald satin, Leicester accent, Punjabi mum. I'm the friend who says 'one drink' and orders the second before you finish the first.

prompts.answer: Three weddings this year, and I danced with someone different at every one.
Leading the search for the best late-night samosa in Southall.

name: Marcus
bio: South Bank strolls after dark, camel coat, roll-neck season forever. I'll take you to a film by the river and a pub for the debate after.

prompts.answer: A film you'd never pick, a pint by the Thames, holding hands across the bridge.
Laugh at my terrible film puns. Or groan, I'll take either.

name: Poppy
bio: Shoreditch after dark, leather jacket, messy hair and a mischievous grin. I'll drag you to a gig you've never heard of and you'll thank me for it.

prompts.answer: Stealing your drink, then your jacket, then your number.
Leaves a party early to go to another party. With me.

name: Zain
bio: Mayfair lounges, sharp blazers, Manchester-born and proud of it. Lawyer who negotiates for a living and never wins against my mum's biryani. Want to try?

prompts.answer: Dress up for the first date. Effort is attractive.
My nan's chicken karahi and a woman who can handle the heat.

name: Jules
bio: Dalston dance floors, glitter on my cheekbones, a satin shirt half a size too big. I'll lend you some sparkle and take you to the after-party.

prompts.answer: Glitter-coated and shameless. Join me.
Sparkly, soft, slightly chaotic.

name: Layla
bio: Dubai Marina nights, champagne satin, Beirut heart. Events manager who knows every rooftop worth knowing. Bring your best line and your best shoes.

prompts.answer: Getting us past any velvet rope with a smile.
Lebanese love songs, a good cologne and a man who can dabke.

name: Omar
bio: Downtown rooftops, linen suits, karak chai addict. Architect from Amman who designs towers and still prefers a desert campfire. Let me show you both.

prompts.answer: Wadi Rum under the stars, then breakfast by the Dead Sea.
Good conversation and better dates. Literally, I love dates.

name: Bea
bio: Sunset walks on the Jumeirah promenade, floral dress, a karaoke voice that has won awards (in my family). Nurse with a big heart and a bigger smile.

prompts.answer: Karaoke. My Celine Dion is a public service.
Packed lunches with little notes. Yes, I'm that girlfriend.

name: Rehan
bio: Hyderabad boy, Dubai life. Fountain shows, late-night shawarma, deals closed before midnight. A fitted black shirt is a lifestyle. Dinner Downtown?

prompts.answer: Driving to Jumeirah for karak and a sea breeze.
Moved to Dubai with one suitcase and a lot of nerve.

name: Sofia
bio: Poolside at dusk, white dress, a glass of red and nowhere I'd rather be. Art consultant from St Petersburg, now in Dubai. Charm me in any language.

prompts.answer: Never fall for a client. Very tempting rule to break.
I speak four languages and flirt best in French.

name: Mei
bio: Marina Bay rooftops, black halter, skyline behind me like it's showing off. Finance by day, cocktail tourist by night. Show me a bar I haven't been to. Good luck.

prompts.answer: Orders the mystery cocktail and makes me try it first.
Rate it after the light show. Atmosphere matters.

name: Hafiz
bio: Clarke Quay river walks, white shirt, a laugh people say is contagious. Pilot who's home just enough to cook you the best nasi lemak in Singapore.

prompts.answer: A layover in Langkawi that we extend by a week.
Like flying: smooth, a bit of turbulence, great views.

name: Shalini
bio: Chinatown rooftops under red lanterns, wine-red wrap dress, sass on tap. Tamil-Singaporean lawyer who'll cross-examine your food choices. Fondly.

prompts.answer: Your 'I can handle spicy' claim. We'll see at the Little India stalls.
Splitting the bill is sexy. So is offering to get the next one.

name: Darren
bio: Hawker-centre connoisseur, satay sticks counted competitively. Software engineer who will chope a table for you with a tissue packet. That's love in Singapore.

prompts.answer: Know your kopi orders. Kopi-C kosong is a green flag.
Two plates of char kway teow, pretending the second one is for you.

name: Gabriela
bio: Brooklyn rooftop, red off-shoulder top, Manhattan glowing behind me. Puerto Rican, salsa-trained, allergic to boring. Take me dancing and see what happens.

prompts.answer: Salsa, bachata and a hip roll that should come with a warning.
Adobo on everything. Sazón in my soul.

name: Jordan
bio: Speakeasies below Lower East Side streets, charcoal suit, an old fashioned stirred slow. Publisher who loves a well-told story. Tell me yours.

prompts.answer: Knowing the password to every hidden bar in Manhattan.
The name of a jazz record I've never heard of.

name: Chloe
bio: Lower East Side girl, leather skirt, bangs I cut myself (don't ask). Fashion assistant with Koreatown karaoke on speed dial. You pick the bar, I pick the song.

prompts.answer: A man who's a little too good at karaoke.
Never have I ever left a party before the karaoke started.

name: Neil
bio: Jersey-raised, Brooklyn-based, bridge-walk enthusiast. Product manager who does stand-up on Tuesdays. Laugh at one joke and I'll buy the dumplings.

prompts.answer: I've opened for a famous comedian. My mum still calls me Neelesh. I've never been late.
Your Hinglish. Lovingly. With pride.

name: Riley
bio: East Village dive bars, vintage leather, a nose ring and a soft spot for sad punk songs. I'll buy the first round and pick the jukebox song. You'll like it.

prompts.answer: Jukebox DJ, and very persuasive about one more song.
A heart tattoo with someone else's initials. I respect the commitment.

name: Simone
bio: Caribana every summer, gold satin and the CN Tower lighting up behind me. Jamaican-Canadian nurse who works hard and parties harder. Wine with me?

prompts.answer: Whining to dancehall the way my aunties taught me.
Oxtail, festival dumplings and a man who can keep up.

name: Rajveer
bio: Brampton born, Distillery District date planner, turtleneck season forever. Accountant with a secret love of slow bhangra remixes. Let me take you skating.

prompts.answer: Skate with me and let me hold your hand 'for safety.'
Tell me I smell good. I picked this cologne for a reason.

name: Hannah
bio: King West patios at golden hour, a glass of red and my auburn hair finally behaving. Teacher with summers off. Spend one with me.

prompts.answer: Farmers' market, patio brunch, a book in the park, wine at sunset.
Quality time and very long patio dinners.

name: Marco
bio: Rooftop drinks downtown, navy blazer, a Filipino family who will adopt you after one dinner. Chef at a Queen West bistro. Lola-approved adobo on request.

prompts.answer: Adobo, lumpia and a karaoke ballad, in that order.
A mango shake on a hot day, a rooftop breeze, a long family dinner.

name: Ella
bio: Bondi to Bronte at golden hour, sundress, salt-air hair. Physio by day, ocean-pool swimmer by dawn. Meet me for a sunset walk and a cheeky spritz.

prompts.answer: Ocean pool at sunrise, a flat white, sandy toes.
You can make me laugh without trying.

name: Elias
bio: Harbour bars at dusk, white linen, the Opera House glowing behind me. Lebanese mum, Aussie mates and a mezze spread that makes friends cry. Come hungry.

prompts.answer: Feeding you knafeh until you can't stand up.
Sharing plates on a first date is the ultimate trust exercise.

name: Grace
bio: Surry Hills rooftops, negroni in hand, laughing at something I definitely shouldn't. Marketing director, sleek bob, impeccable taste in people and bars. Mostly bars.

prompts.answer: Laughing at your joke a second too long. Intentionally.
A midnight kiss on New Year's Eve with the harbour fireworks going off.

name: Lachlan
bio: Manly local, surf before work, ferry home at sunset. The sun-bleached hair is natural, I swear. Let me teach you to stand up on a board. Very hands-on lessons.

prompts.answer: Ferry to Manly, fish and chips on the sand, a sunset dip.
Wants one more wave before dark.

name: Lena
bio: Friedrichshain weekends, platinum bob, silver everything. Graphic designer who dances like nobody's watching (they are). Find me on the floor at 3 a.m.

prompts.answer: Eyes closed, bass in my chest, smiling at strangers.
Exactly the person you were looking for on the dance floor.

name: Deniz
bio: Kreuzberg canal at dusk, black denim, my grandmother's börek recipe memorised. Sound engineer with a soft spot for old Turkish love songs. Let's walk.

prompts.answer: 'Bir kahve daha?' One more coffee. Always yes.
Your döner order. Too much sauce is never enough.

name: Kai
bio: Buzz cut, leather jacket, red-lit hallways and the kind of grin that gets me into trouble. DJ on weekends, tattoo apprentice on weekdays. Come to my set.

prompts.answer: The bass drops and we look at each other at the same moment.
Dedicating the next track to you without saying a word.

name: Felix
bio: Natural wine bars in Neukölln, navy knit, a good bottle and better conversation. Architect who cooks on Sundays and listens on Mondays. Let me pour you a glass.

prompts.answer: Cooking for you with the radio on. Dancing badly in the kitchen.
Natural wine is a personality test. Let's see how you do.

name: Camille
bio: Golden hour on the quais of the Seine, red dress, Notre-Dame behind me. Curator who lives on croissants and compliments. Recite me something in French.

prompts.answer: Anything in French, slowly. Bonus points for Prévert.
Sunset on the Seine, a bottle of Sancerre, getting lost on the way home on purpose.

name: Karim
bio: Late-night café terraces in the 10th, black shirt, a glass of red. Chef who knows every bistro that stays open after midnight. One more glass, then I'll walk you home.

prompts.answer: Ordering for the table in perfect French, then winking.
The one who knows where to get couscous at 2 a.m.

name: Ines
bio: Montmartre steps at night, emerald dress, Sacré-Cœur glowing above. Singer in a jazz trio near Pigalle. Come to my set; I'll find you in the crowd.

prompts.answer: Singing Nina Simone like I'm singing it to you.
Under a Montmartre street lamp? Easy ten.

name: Louis
bio: Paris rooftops at blue hour, the Eiffel Tower sparkling on the hour. Photographer in a Breton stripe, cliché and proud. Let me take your portrait at sunset.

prompts.answer: Tell me my photos make you look good. They will.
A night train to Nice and a long afternoon on the Riviera.

name: Beatriz
bio: Miradouro sunsets in Alfama, white linen, fado drifting up from below. Translator who speaks four languages and dreams in Portuguese. Take me to a fado house?

prompts.answer: A line of fado, out of tune but from the heart.
Pastéis de nata warm from the oven, tram 28, a quiet view over the river.

name: Tiago
bio: Bairro Alto after dark, a ginjinha in each hand (one is for you). Bartender who knows every alley, every song and every shortcut home. Shall we?

prompts.answer: Leading a ginjinha crawl through the alleys of Bairro Alto.
Are you a pastel de nata? Because I could have you every morning.

name: Nadia
bio: Riverside drinks with the big red bridge glowing behind me, orange dress, warm laugh. Cape Verdean roots, Lisbon heart, morna on repeat. Dance with me?

prompts.answer: Funaná until my feet give up. They never do.
Cachupa on Sundays, cooked together, eaten slowly.

name: Jiwoo
bio: Gangnam rooftops, little black dress, the city lit up like it's for me. Fashion buyer and dance-cover veteran. You buy the soju, I'll pick the next spot.

prompts.answer: Every K-pop choreography, flawless. Try to keep up.
Pouring your drink with two hands and holding eye contact.

name: Minjun
bio: Hongdae streets after dark, oversized blazer, a coffee in hand even at midnight. Stylist by day, busker on weekends. Stop and listen to one song.

prompts.answer: Your hot coffee in July. Iced americano supremacy.
I've styled a music video. I can't parallel park. I've never lost at rock-paper-scissors.

name: Seoyeon
bio: Han River evenings at dusk, trench coat, fried chicken and beer on a blanket. Editor at a publishing house who still believes in K-drama romance. Prove me right.

prompts.answer: Chimaek on the riverbank, bridge lights, one shared earphone.
Writing you letters. Real ones, with stamps.

name: Haneul
bio: Itaewon lounges, silver hair, oversized shirt and a grin that gets me free drinks. Game designer, karaoke menace, terrible at leaving parties.

prompts.answer: The one who knows the after-party address.
Your karaoke song choice. Then I'll sing it better.

name: Yuna
bio: Shibuya crossing at night, camel trench, bangs perfectly in place. Magazine editor who's always running late but worth the wait. Get lost in Tokyo with me.

prompts.answer: Konbini snacks at midnight, a quiet bar in Shimokita, warm hands in cold weather.
Like Tokyo at night: bright, a little overwhelming, impossible to forget.

name: Ren
bio: Izakaya alleys in Shinjuku, red lanterns, a highball and a story. Sound designer who knows the best yakitori in every narrow lane. Join me for a second round.

prompts.answer: I know a bar that seats six. I'll get us in.
Charcoal-grilled skewers at midnight and someone to share them with.

name: Aoi
bio: Ginza cocktail bars, black velvet, a bartender who knows my order before I sit down. Gallerist with excellent taste and very little time. Make it worth my while.

prompts.answer: A slow smile over the rim of a coupe glass.
Never on a weeknight. Tuesday is a weeknight. I'm free on Tuesday.

name: Haruto
bio: Tokyo rooftop nights, Tokyo Tower glowing orange behind me, denim jacket on. Animator who'll draw you as a manga hero. Let's find a late-night ramen spot.

prompts.answer: Drawing you into my sketchbook as the main character.
Starts with a missed last train and ends at sunrise in Odaiba.

name: Ploy
bio: Rooftop bars over the Chao Phraya, emerald satin, Bangkok glittering to the horizon. Fashion PR with a weakness for mango sticky rice and men with good manners.

prompts.answer: Mango sticky rice at 1 a.m. Every time.
Tell me I look like I own the rooftop.

name: Krit
bio: Yaowarat after dark is my kitchen. Chef who knows which stall has the best crab omelette and which has the longest queue (worth it). Eat with me.

prompts.answer: Thai spicy. Like, real Thai spicy. Bring tissues.
Ordering in three dialects and getting the secret menu.

name: Nont
bio: Riverside bars with Wat Arun glowing across the water, silk shirt, long hair down. Florist and part-time poet. Bring me a story and I'll bring you jasmine.

prompts.answer: Flowers, arranged like a letter you can read.
The name of your favourite flower, and why.

name: Adaeze
bio: Lagos rooftops at golden hour, ankara wrap, Chapman in hand. Fashion designer who dresses half of Lekki. Ambitious, warm, slightly bossy. You'll like it.

prompts.answer: A man who can dance to Afrobeats and talk about his five-year plan.
Jollof that rivals my mum's. Good luck.

name: Tobi
bio: Lekki beach lounge at sunset, white linen, Afrobeats in the air, lanterns coming on. Fintech founder who works hard and dances harder. Skip the small talk with me.

prompts.answer: Shaku shaku, zanku, whatever the DJ wants. I'm ready.
First dates should end with dancing. No exceptions.

name: Temi
bio: Afrobeats clubs on Victoria Island, sequins on, braids swinging. Content creator by day, last one on the dance floor by night. Keep up, darling.

prompts.answer: Shining like a disco ball and twice as distracting.
A man who knows every Afrobeats lyric. Trouble.

name: Jabari
bio: Westlands rooftops, olive blazer, the city lights spread out below. Investment analyst who'd rather be on safari. Let me plan you a weekend in Naivasha.

prompts.answer: The Maasai Mara at sunrise, then a beach week in Diani.
Planning the perfect date, down to the playlist.

name: Wanjiru
bio: Rooftop sunsets in Kilimani, yellow sundress, Kenyan coffee I'll defend to anyone. Environmental engineer who hikes the Ngong Hills for fun. Join me?

prompts.answer: Mandazi warm from the pan, rain on a tin roof, Sunday hikes.
Knowing the difference between good coffee and great coffee.

name: Baraka
bio: Nairobi club regular, patterned shirt, a smile that's got me into every VIP section. Music producer. If the song playing is mine, you have to dance with me.

prompts.answer: Gengetone energy, every step on point.
The guy who orders nyama choma for the whole table at 3 a.m.

name: Larissa
bio: Vila Madalena murals at night, black top, gold necklace and a caipirinha. Street-art photographer. Wander the alleys with me and I'll show you the walls nobody photographs.

prompts.answer: Taking your photo and keeping the best one for myself.
Brazilian: warm, sweet and very hard to resist.

name: Rafael
bio: Rooftop sunsets over São Paulo's endless skyline, linen shirt, cachaça in hand. Doctor, samba lover, suffering football fan since birth. Let me cook you feijoada.

prompts.answer: Feijoada on Saturdays, cooked slowly, eaten together.
Bossa nova lyrics. Tom Jobim, preferably.

name: Julia
bio: Samba bars in Bixiga, red dress, curls flying. Dance teacher who believes every night is Carnival. Don't know samba? Perfect, I'll teach you up close.

prompts.answer: Samba no pé until the band packs up.
Started at a Carnival bloco and ended in Rio. Still not sure how.

name: Diego
bio: Roma Norte mezcalerías by candlelight, dark shirt, a moustache that's working. Bartender who'll pour you something smoky and tell you a story, slowly.

prompts.answer: Mezcal with orange slices and sal de gusano, served with a slow smile.
A bolero, sung softly in Spanish.

name: Valeria
bio: Condesa terraces under the jacarandas, black off-shoulder dress, red lipstick and red wine. Architect with a fiery temper and a soft heart. Take me dancing.

prompts.answer: Churros with chocolate and a man who can salsa.
One to ten? Depends on the mariachi.

name: Alex
bio: Gallery openings in Roma, an embroidered shirt from my abuela's village, a glass of red and a big grin. Visual artist who'll ask about your dreams and then paint them.

prompts.answer: Canvases everywhere, marigolds in jars, a hammock you won't want to leave.
We stay until the gallery turns the lights off.

name: Sienna
bio: DTLA rooftops at golden hour, cream knit dress, beach waves I swear are natural. Screenwriter. I'll write you into my next script if the first date goes well.

prompts.answer: Like a romcom, but with better dialogue.
Tell me my dialogue is sharp. Then tell me I look good. In that order.

name: Andre
bio: Venice boardwalk sunsets, white linen, a jacket over my arm for when you get cold. Music teacher who still hoops on the beach courts. Walk with me.

prompts.answer: Sunset on the boardwalk, tacos by the pier, a playlist made just for you.
Tell me about your favourite album like it changed your life.

name: Anika
bio: Mulholland overlook at night, black satin, leather jacket on my shoulders. Bay Area-raised, LA-based entertainment lawyer. Show me your city; I'll show you my favourite view.

prompts.answer: Drove up to Mulholland at midnight with someone I'd met that afternoon.
Never date someone in the industry. Rule bent, not broken.

name: Daniel
bio: Koreatown karaoke nights, bomber jacket, mic firmly in hand. Software engineer who takes ballads very seriously. Duet with me and I'll buy the KBBQ.

prompts.answer: A power ballad with a key change. Hold my soju.
Are you a karaoke song? Because I've been practising you all week.
